strategies.name: EmptyDaySeedSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: Empty queue and some empty days produces no placements
Plan_NoEmptyDays_YieldsNothing: All days have at least one occupied slot produces no placements
Plan_SingleEmptyDay_SeedsOneLesson: One empty day with 1 queue item places 1 lesson in first free slot (slot 1)
Plan_TwoEmptyDays_SeedsOneEach: Two empty days with 2 queue items gets 1 placement per day
Plan_MoreEmptyDaysThanQueueItems_SeedsUntilQueueExhausted: 3 empty days with 2 queue items only uses 2 days
Plan_MultipleSubjects_RoundRobinCycles: Two subjects across 2 empty days cycles Math then Physics
Plan_EmptyDaysWithDifferentSlots_SeedsEarliestDayFirst: Empty days are seeded in chronological order
Plan_EmptyDayWithOccupiedSlotsSkipped: A day with 1 occupied slot is not empty so skipped

strategies.name: FairShareSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: Empty queue produces no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_PlacesAll: Single subject with enough slots places all items
Plan_TwoSubjectsEqualProportions_AlternatesFairly: Math=3 Physics=3 alternates evenly
Plan_TwoSubjectsUnequalProportions_MaintainsRatio: Math=4 Physics=2 maintains ~2:1 ratio
Plan_ThreeSubjects_MinimizesSquaredDeviation: Math=3 Physics=2 Chem=1 distribution stays close to initial 50/33/17%
Plan_QueueExhaustedEarly_EndsGracefully: More subjects than available slots stops gracefully
Plan_SingleSlot_PlacesHighestDesired: Only 1 slot picks the subject with largest desired proportion

strategies.name: LargestQueueFirstSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: Empty queue produces no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_PlacesAll: Single subject places all items
Plan_TwoSubjects_PicksLargerEveryTime: Math=5 Physics=3 always picks Math until tie then first-in-order, then Physics
Plan_ThreeSubjects_AlwaysLargest: Math=2 Physics=5 Chem=3 always picks Physics (largest) first
Plan_QueueExhaustedEarly_EndsGracefully: More queue items than slots stops gracefully
Plan_SingleSlot_PlacesLargestRemaining: Math=1 Physics=3 places Physics

strategies.name: LeadingChunkGrowthSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: Empty queue produces no placements
Plan_AllDaysEmpty_YieldsNothing: No non-empty days means no chunks to grow
Plan_AllDaysFull_YieldsNothing: All 6 slots occupied means no free pair before any chunk
Plan_SingleDaySingleChunk_GrowsChunkTowardStart: Occupied [3,4,5] places in slot 2 then slot 1
Plan_TwoDaysDifferentChunkLengths_GrowsShortestFirst: Day1 chunk length 1 gets filled before Day2 chunk length 2
Plan_ChunkReachesSlot1_StopsGrowing: Chunk growing left stops when slot 1 is occupied
Plan_MultipleSubjects_RoundRobinCycles: 2 subjects across 2 days with chunks cycle correctly
Plan_ThreeDaysMixedChunks_PriorityQueueOrder: Chunks of lengths 1, 2, 3 fill length-1 first every time

strategies.name: RandomSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: Empty queue produces no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_PlacesAll: Single subject always picked by random
Plan_TwoSubjects_SeededRandom_ProducesDeterministicSequence: Same seed produces same sequence
Plan_TwoSubjects_DifferentSeeds_DifferentSequence: Different seeds produce different sequences
Plan_QueueExhaustedEarly_EndsGracefully: More subjects than slots stops gracefully
Plan_MultipleSubjects_AllPlacedWithinTotal: Total placements = min(slots, total queue)

strategies.name: RoundRobinSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: Empty queue produces no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_PlacesAll: Single subject places all items
Plan_TwoSubjectsEven_AlternatesCorrectly: Math=3 Physics=3 alternates Math Physics Math Physics Math Physics
Plan_ThreeSubjects_OrderMatchesQueueKeyOrder: Queue order is Math Physics Chem -> cycles in that order
Plan_ThreeSubjectsUneven_SkipsExhausted: Math=1 Physics=3 Chem=3 skips Math when exhausted
Plan_QueueExhaustedEarly_EndsGracefully: More subjects than slots stops gracefully
Plan_TwoSubjects_SingleSlotEach_SingleAlternation: Math=1 Physics=1 places Math then Physics

strategies.name: SmallestQueueFirstSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: Empty queue produces no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_PlacesAll: Single subject places all items
Plan_TwoSubjects_PicksSmallerEveryTime: Math=3 Physics=5 picks Math (smaller) first exhausts it then Physics
Plan_ThreeSubjects_AlwaysSmallest: Math=3 Physics=5 Chem=1 picks Chem (smallest) first
Plan_Tie_BetweenTwo_PicksFirstInIterationOrder: Math=3 Physics=3 picks first in iteration order
Plan_QueueExhaustedEarly_EndsGracefully: More subjects than slots stops gracefully

strategies.name: TrailingChunkGrowthSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: Empty queue produces no placements
Plan_AllDaysEmpty_YieldsNothing: No non-empty days means no chunks to grow
Plan_AllDaysFull_YieldsNothing: All 6 slots occupied means no free pair after any chunk
Plan_SingleDaySingleTrailingChunk_GrowsTowardEnd: Occupied [1,2,3] places in slot 4 then 5 then 6
Plan_TwoDaysDifferentChunkLengths_GrowsShortestFirst: Day1 trailing chunk length 1 gets filled before Day2 length 2
Plan_ChunkReachesSlot6_StopsGrowing: Chunk growing right stops when slot 6 is occupied
Plan_MultipleSubjects_RoundRobinCycles: 2 subjects across 2 days with trailing chunks cycle correctly
Plan_MidDayChunk_GrowsTowardEnd: Day has [1,2,4] places after trailing chunk [4] in slot 5 then 6

strategies.name: WeightedRandomSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: Empty queue produces no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_PlacesAll: Single subject always picked by weighted random
Plan_TwoSubjectsEqualWeight_SeededDeterministic: Math=3 Physics=3 same seed produces same sequence
Plan_TwoSubjectsUnequalWeight_LargerIsMoreFrequent: Math=1 Physics=9 seeded random shows Physics dominates
Plan_QueueExhaustedEarly_EndsGracefully: More subjects than slots stops gracefully
Plan_MultipleSubjects_AllPlaceWithinTotal: Total placements = min(slots, total queue)
